data.name: Laham
data.gender_notes: Laham is used as a unisex name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Food derived from animal carcasses, usually consumed cooked. The name Laham carries the meaning “Meat” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic. Parents who choose Laham usually hope their child will grow to embody meat and live with faith, good character and purpose.

data.etymology: Laham belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Meat.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Laham total 8, giving a life-path number of 8. Number 8 is linked with Saturn and with the qualities of ambition, resilience and material success.

in_arabic.name: لحم
in_arabic.meaning: لحم تعني اللحم أو الجلد أو القوة في اللغة العربية
in_arabic.long_meaning: لحم هو اسم عربي يعود إلى أصول لغوية تعبر عن القوة و الثراء. في اللغة العربية، لحم يعني اللحم أو الجلد، ويشير إلى القوة والمنعة. كما يمكن أن يرتبط بالغذاء والنماء. في بعض السياقات، قد يكون له معاني متعلقة بالحماية أو الدعم.

in_urdu.name: لحم
in_urdu.meaning: لحم کا مطلب ہے مضبوطی، توانائی، یا گوشت
in_urdu.long_meaning: لحم ایک عربی نام ہے جس کا مطلب ہے مضبوطی، توانائی، یا گوشت۔ یہ نام جنوبی ایشیائی مسلم معاشرے میں اہمیت رکھتا ہے، جہاں یہ قوت و توانائی کی علامت کے طور پر دیکھا جاتا ہے۔ اس کا تعلق غذاء اور نمو سے بھی ہو سکتا ہے، اور بعض اوقات حفاظت یا مدد کے مفہوم سے بھی منسلک ہوتا ہے۔

in_hindi.name: लहम
in_hindi.meaning: लहम का अर्थ है शक्ति, ऊर्जा या मांस
in_hindi.long_meaning: लहम एक अरबी नाम है जिसका अर्थ है शक्ति, ऊर्जा या मांस। यह नाम भारतीय मुस्लिम समुदाय में महत्वपूर्ण है, जहां यह शक्ति और ऊर्जा का प्रतीक माना जाता है। इसका संबंध भोजन और विकास से भी हो सकता है, और कभी-कभी सुरक्षा या समर्थन के अर्थ से भी जुड़ता है।

in_pashto.name: لحم
in_pashto.meaning: لحم معنی یې قوت، انرژي یا غوښ
in_pashto.long_meaning: لحم د عربي نوم دی چې معنی یې قوت، انرژي یا غوښ دی. دا نوم د افغان او پښتون دودیزو ټولنو کې مهم دی، چیرته چې دا د قوت او انرژي نښه ګڼل کیږي. دا ممکن د خوراک او ودې سره اړیکه ولري، او کله ناکله د ساتنې یا مالتړ مفهوم سره هم تړاو لري.

in_english.name: Laham
in_english.meaning: Laham means strength, power, or meat in Arabic
in_english.long_meaning: Laham is an Arabic name derived from the root 'L-H-M', which means strength, power, or meat. In Islamic tradition, this name is associated with attributes of resilience and vitality. It may also relate to nourishment and growth. Historically, names like Laham have been used across various Muslim cultures, symbolizing desirable qualities such as fortitude and support.

data.cultural_impact: The Arabic term "Laham" refers to meat derived from animal carcasses, typically consumed after being cooked. In the Islamic context, it holds great significance as this source of food aligns with the teachings of the religion. The consumption of Laham is viewed as an act of faith, as Muslims follow the dietary laws established during the prophetic era. It is considered a form of respect for the divine creations and recognizes the importance of sustenance and nourishment. Furthermore, sharing and communal dining experiences built around dishes made from Laham strengthen the bonds between Muslim communities.
data.spiritual_significance: The spiritual essence of Laham lies in its representation of unity and ultimate submission to God, as the sacrifices and offerings made through the consumption of Halal meat serve as a reminder of the vulnerability, transience, and interconnectedness of all life forms. In the act of preparing and sharing Halal meat, Muslims embody the values of compassion, mindfulness, and reverence for divine guidance. These values are believed to provide overall holistic wellbeing for individuals who lead a balanced and pious life, based on the teachings of the Islamic faith.
